Commercial Governance

Manage contracts, fiscal caps, and commercial acceptance processes.

commercial

Commercial governance API endpoints.

This module provides the REST API endpoints for contractual pricing mechanisms, fiscal year spending cap monitoring, and formal Government milestone acceptance gates.

Endpoints

Contract Structure

  • POST /contracts — Create a new project contract structure.

  • GET /contracts/{project_id} — Retrieve the contract structure for a project.

  • PUT /contracts/{project_id} — Update an existing contract structure.

  • DELETE /contracts/{project_id} — Delete a contract structure.

TCIF Fee Adjustment

  • POST /contracts/{project_id}/tcif-fee-adjustment — Calculate the Target Cost Incentive Fee (TCIF) fee adjustment for a given projected cost.

Fiscal Year Spending Caps

  • POST /fiscal-caps — Create a new fiscal year spending cap.

  • GET /fiscal-caps/{control_account_id} — List all fiscal year caps for a control account.

  • PUT /fiscal-caps/{cap_id} — Update an existing fiscal year cap.

  • DELETE /fiscal-caps/{cap_id} — Delete a fiscal year cap.

  • POST /fiscal-caps/{control_account_id}/validate — Validate the fiscal year spend profile against allocated caps.

Government Acceptance Milestones

  • POST /acceptance — Create a new government acceptance milestone.

  • GET /acceptance/{node_id} — List all acceptance milestones for a deliverable.

  • PUT /acceptance/{milestone_id} — Update an acceptance milestone (e.g., sign off as ACCEPTED).

  • DELETE /acceptance/{milestone_id} — Delete an acceptance milestone.

Access Control

All endpoints require JWT authentication via the get_current_user dependency. The authenticated user must have sufficient clearance to access the underlying portfolio nodes.

What You Can Do

  • View: Get project contract structure.

  • View: List fiscal year spending caps.

  • Create: Create fiscal year spending cap.

  • Create: Create government acceptance milestone.

  • Update: Update fiscal year spending cap.

Removing Items

  • Delete: Delete fiscal year spending cap.
